title: Amaranthium (Time to Gear Up)
description: The Seventh Installment to the "Amaranthium" series
body:
Amaranthium (Time to Gear Up) is a mod about, well, a few more weapons, including (a few) hollow knight references, a new Biome to spawn in the overworld. A new, but weak, Shield. Souls, Crooked totems, a new mob called "The Crooked", adds death (The Grim Reaper) as a boss who one-taps.
Water, Earth, Fire and Air bending gloves.
A cutlass (the sprite is backwards)
a one-time use axe made entirely out of sticks.
AND, an "incredibly hard to obtain" Pickaxe that is OP for a pickaxe, with increadibly high durability, (no damage, just to balance it,) Netherite Tier, insane efficiency, high enchantment level, and 100 attack speed.

There are also the following Gems, Dusts and Ingots added, all with their own sets of armour, weapons, and tools:
1. Rubies
2. Sapphires
3. Alexandrite
4. Benitoite
5. Black Opal
6. Grandidierite
7. Uranium
8. Cerium
9. Europium
10. Rust



New Block:
Ritual Table
this table is used to convert Echo Shards into Strange matter.

Using JEI with this mod is advised, as this mod has a lot of recipies.
This mod is made to give the same feel as the rest of the "Amaranthium" series.


Anyone who wants to make an addon for this mod can if they wish.
ENJOY :)
